description:
Two incredible V10s are about to go head-to-head!

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-28-09-26

Who’s ready for an American vs Japan showdown?! 

We’ve got our hands on a 4th generation Dodge Viper ACR, and it’s lining up against the legendary Lexus LFA! 

The question is, which V10 will make it to the finish line first? Let’s take a closer look at the stats…

First up we have the Dodge Viper ACR. It’s powered by an 8.4-litre naturally aspirated V10 which produces 608hp and 760Nm. However, it’s had a slight tune applied to it, meaning the output is more likely to be around 650hp and 800Nm! All of this power is sent to the rear wheels via a 6-speed manual, and it tips the scales at 1,533kg. As of today, it’s valued at around £130,000.

title: Does Size Matter? Lexus LFA v Dodge Viper: DRAG RACE
